title: Spear Hero’s Excessiveness
paragraphs: “…Do you have anything to say?”
Big sister raises her hammer high and gets ready to swing it at me.
“It’s a misunderstanding! I acted with all sincerity, just as Father and you told me to!”
I steeled myself and once again played the fool.
“Then how in the world did it turn out like this?!”
“GAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH—”

Big sister points at Father, who is howling at the moon in the scorched earth. As the loop is about to begin again in a matter of seconds, big sister shows up and threatens me. I’ve taken a fair amount of damage myself and been blown away, I say. By the way, we’re currently at the former site of Melromarc’s castle. Father’s Dark Curse Burning turned everything into scorched earth, and everyone except me was reduced to ashes. Ren and Itsuki too.
“…The loop is about to activate. What did you do?! I’ve never seen Naofumi like that before!”
“I just did as I was told!”
Without saving Father, I sincerely cornered him!
“Yeah, sure…”
Big sister gives me a very suspicious look.
“Let’s hear it first. Tell me exactly what you did. Spear Hero, what did you do during the one month before the loop started?”
“I knew about the conspiracy, but reluctantly went along with the pig and scum’s scheme and pinned false charges on Father.”
“Okay. That one couldn’t be helped. Next.”

“Even though acting with the pig made me sick, when we actually got going, all I had to do was go to the hunting grounds and cheer from behind. After hunting, I basically had free time, so it was painful but easy.”

Come to think of it, the pig wasn’t with me all the time. Outside of hunting, she seemed to just indulge in luxury—spa treatments, fine dining, that sort of thing. In that sense, I had more free time than expected. Well, I held back the urge to kill her countless times, and I don’t know how many holes opened in my stomach from the stress of being around her. There were even rumors around the castle that I was chronically ill or something.
“I don’t know why I have to know your actions, but I guess that’s how it is. That guy probably was doing stuff like that. And even if you don’t talk, he’s the type to do whatever he wants anyway.”

Big sister seems to fully understand that too. Well, during my free time at night, I’d raise some filolials separately to unwind and relieve stress. Ah, of course, I’d use a portal to go to another country and raise them there. Even annoying jobs like fulfilling national requests, I followed the same path as the original world.
“So, why is Naofumi howling like that with such a terrifying expression without bringing me along?”
“I don’t know. I sincerely cornered Father, but…”
“…Cornered? Be specific. What exactly did you do?”
I feel like big sister’s attitude is gradually becoming more severe.
“Let’s see… First, I’d meet Father face-to-face every day and look down on him saying, ‘still hanging around here, you rapist!’ and insulted him.”
Big sister’s expression grows even darker and starts radiating killing intent, but I continue.

“Eventually, whenever Father was seen in the castle town, the city, or villages, I’d shout, ‘It’s the Rapist Shield Hero! Everyone, throw stones!’ and riled the crowd up. Everyone would laugh and throw stones at him—it was disgusting.”

I think around the fifth day after the false accusation, Father’s shield turned into the Shield of Wrath. Before I knew it, he was wearing some ominous armor—probably a skill-generated one—and started walking around with a dead-serious look in his eyes. And for some reason, he wasn’t traveling with any slaves like big sister or the others.
His level looked… moderately high, didn’t it? Probably higher than during the loops where I didn’t get involved. Based on sightings, it seemed like he had secluded himself deep in the mountains.

How did he raise his level away from people and without any allies? My guess is he took out monsters using counterattack effects or something. There were rumors that adventurers who tried to mess with him were turned to ashes. According to scum, he was even starting to talk about putting a bounty on Father’s head soon. Then, when the Wave occurred, Father ran toward the rift and turned the Dimensional Chimera into ash, laughing triumphantly. After that, during the post-battle celebration, just like planned, I went along with the pig and scum’s scheme, picked a fight with Father, and landed a controlled blow on him the moment the duel started. Well, he collapsed once because of that, but then he immediately got up, seemed to charge his power, and unleashed a massive counterattack flame that engulfed the entire castle.
“—That’s how it went.”
“This is for Naofumi’s sorrow!”
With a thud, big sister swung her hammer down on me without hesitation. I barely dodged it by a hair.
“That was dangerous!?”
Was she seriously trying to kill me!? But it seems like big sister held back quite a bit. Eventually, with a tone of interrogation, big sister said:
“You interfered with Naofumi that much?”
At her remark, I start to think again. Come to think of it, I hadn’t even met Father face-to-face until the first Wave happened.
“To incite people to throw stones… You must really resent Naofumi, don’t you?”
“I don’t. Now that I think about it, in the original world, we didn’t even meet until the Dragon Hourglass when I was with you.”
“Then why did you do all this?!”
“Because I was told I had to harden my heart and corner Father.”
“Know your limits!”
Big sister yelled at me with intense anger.
“I told you to follow the original world’s path! Spear Hero, after taking part in the false charges, you were supposed to stay out of Naofumi’s way.”
That’s risky though. You never know when Father might get killed. …Or so I thought, but all I could do was nod at big sister’s furious tone.
“Honestly… It breaks my heart thinking of Naofumi, getting stones thrown at him everywhere he went, thinking the whole world was against him.”
“I hardened my heart too, I say. I’d like to be recognized for that.”
“…I’ll kill you, you know?”
Big sister now radiates even stronger killing intent than before, threatening me. My spine freezes and I feel like I can’t move.
“In any case, there’s nothing we can do now except loop again. But I have to get to Naofumi and the others quickly. Just follow the original timeline so you can see Filo sooner.”
“Understood!”
“Yeah, right…”
Big sister gave me a suspicious look—just like Father would.
“For now, just buy me, get through the Wave, declare the slaves free, and then have your duel with Naofumi. Got it?”
“Yes!”
Big sister was clearly still doubting whether I truly understood.
“Well then, I’m counting on you.”
Saying that, big sister vanished with a *whoosh*, and the loop activated.
Whoa… I really made her mad. Looks like I need to secretly lend my support to both big sister and Father in my own way.
If I do that, maybe once Filo-tan is born, they’ll happily let me have her! And so, I set out to face the next loop.
